name: Dancing Line: Community Edition
summary: Dancing Line: Community Edition is a remake of the official Dancing Line game, with rewritten main code for a smoother experience. The game includes over 90 levels! In addition to official levels, it also includes dozens of carefully selected fan-made levels. DLCE features GAS account system, allowing players to easily sync their progress across different devices via cloud saves. Furthermore, we've adapted the Apple iOS version to include various native system features, such as Game Center achievements and leaderboards, iCloud saves, custom game icons, iPad landscape mode, and system text accessibility settings.
